intervals.quote: We started a new project, NEw generation WIMP-search with Advanced Gaseous tracking device Experiment (NEWAGE) in 2003

intervals.label: underground direction-sensitive WIMP searches
intervals.note: Start verified (2007). Open interval: the latest sources read (TAUP 2025 and IDM 2026 contributions by the collaboration) describe NEWAGE as a running experiment in the Kamioka underground observatory, with a recently upgraded detector.
intervals.quote: NEWAGE started direction-sensitive direct WIMP searches in an underground laboratory in 2007 and has updated the results since then.

intervals.label: NEWAGE-0.3a first underground dark matter run (Run5, 0.524 kg d)
intervals.quote: The first underground dark matter run with the NEWAGE-0.3a detector took place from September 11, 2008 until December 4, 2008 in Laboratory B, Kamioka Observatory

intervals.label: NEWAGE-0.3b' run (Run14 to Run18, 434.85 live days)

intervals.quote: The search was carried out from July 2013 to August 2017 (Run14 to Run18) at the Kamioka underground laboratory.

intervals.label: NEWAGE-0.3b'' run (eight periods, 318.0 live days)
intervals.note: The detector was refurbished with the low-alpha micro-pixel chamber (LAmicro-PIC) in 2018.
intervals.quote: The measurement was carried out from December 12th, 2017 to March 26th, 2020, subdivided into eight periods.

summary.plain: NEWAGE is a Japanese dark matter experiment in the Kamioka mine that tries to tell which way a dark matter particle came from. It tracks the recoil of a nucleus in a low-pressure CF4 gas chamber, which could show whether recoils point back along the direction of the Solar System's motion through the Galaxy.
summary.technical: NEw generation WIMP-search with an Advanced Gaseous tracking device Experiment: direction-sensitive WIMP search with low-pressure CF4 micro-TPCs read out by a micro pixel chamber (mu-PIC) with GEM pre-amplification, in Laboratory B of the Kamioka Observatory (2700 m.w.e.). Spin-dependent WIMP-proton limits from direction-sensitive analyses: 5400 pb at 150 GeV/c^2 (NEWAGE-0.3a, 0.524 kg d, 2010), 50 pb at 100 GeV/c^2 (NEWAGE-0.3b'', 2021) and 25.7 pb at 150 GeV/c^2 (3.18 kg d, 2023).

technology.quote: The detection volume was 31 × 31× 41 cm3 in size and was filled with low-pressure gas of CF4 at 76 Torr (0.1 atm) for this work.
technology.value: Low-pressure CF4 gas micro-time-projection chamber read out by a micro pixel chamber (mu-PIC) with GEM pre-amplification
